listUsers.description:
Minimum role: User Administrator.

Returns a paginated list of users. Supports SCIM filtering, pagination, and count controls. Maximum 100 users per call.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
SCIM filter expression. The Anaplan implementation supports only a subset; unsupported operators or attributes return 400 with scimType `invalidValue`.

**Operators:** `eq`, `ne`, `pr`, `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le`.

**Logical operators / grouping:** `and`, `or`, and precedence grouping with `( )` (including nested groups).

**Filterable attributes:** `userName`, `active`, `id`, `externalId`, and `name` sub-attributes via dot notation such as `name.familyName`.

parameters.name: startIndex
parameters.description: 1-based index of the first result in the current set of list results.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page. Maximum allowed value is 100.

schemas.description: List of SCIM schema URNs declaring the envelope type; always `["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"]`.

totalResults.description: Total number of results matching the query.

startIndex.description: 1-based index of the first result returned.

itemsPerPage.description: Number of results returned in this response.

items.description: Anaplan SCIM User resource. Implements the SCIM core User schema plus Anaplan-specific entitlements.

schemas.description: List of SCIM schema URNs that declare the resource type. For the Anaplan User resource, include `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User`.

id.description: Anaplan-assigned hex-32 GUID for this user (read-only).

externalId.description: Unique identifier assigned by the provisioning client. Format is caller-controlled; no pattern constraint.

userName.description: Username of the user. Required and unique (read-only after creation).

name.description: Components of the user's real name.

formatted.description: Formatted full name (read-only, generated from givenName + familyName).

displayName.description: Display name (read-only, generated from givenName + familyName).

active.description: Controls whether the user can log into Anaplan.

emails.description: Email addresses for the user. Only `work` type is supported.

type.description: The type of email. Only `work` is supported.

entitlements.description: Anaplan-specific workspace entitlements for the user. Not a standard SCIM attribute. Maximum 50 workspaces per create call.

value.description: The target resource ID of the entitlement. For `WORKSPACE` type this is a workspace GUID from `GET /workspaces` in the [Integration API](https://help.anaplan.com/integration-api-v20-3107aa54-d12b-4c48-9550-3561c84adbb2) (`workspaces[].id`); for `WORKSPACE_IDS` it is a comma-delimited list of those GUIDs.

type.description: Entitlement grouping format. `WORKSPACE` — one object per workspace (use this when writing); `WORKSPACE_IDS` — single object whose `value` is a comma-delimited list of workspace GUIDs; `WORKSPACE_NAMES` — single object whose `value` is a comma-delimited list of workspace names. Responses typically include all three variants for the same workspace set.

primary.description: Indicates the primary entitlement. At most one entry may be `true`.

createUser.description:
